homepageStories.heading: Four working days, and the choices behind them.
homepageStories.lead: A buyer in a chat. A job on site. A shipment already on the road. The software is built for that day.

homepageStoriesCards.title: The offer
homepageStoriesCards.text: The buyer asks in the chat they already use. The offer is drafted there, and a person approves it before it is sent.

homepageStoriesCards.title: The job
homepageStoriesCards.text: The checklist, the photos and the approval stay with the job. The office sees what was recorded on site.

homepageStoriesCards.title: The shipment
homepageStoriesCards.text: Booking, documents, customs and status stay with the shipment. Nobody rebuilds it from an inbox.

homepageStoriesCards.title: The choices
homepageStoriesCards.text: Why the software sits where the work already is, and why a person still approves what leaves the building.
